newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 ends little changed, off day's low.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 ends little changed, off day's low.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index stalled on Tuesday, weighed down by disappointing results from a couple of large blue chip companies and continued strength in sterling, dealers said.
The benchmark index finished 3.4 points lower at 4,304.3, with decliners narrowly outpacing advancers 51 to 47, despite a firm gilt market and a solid rebound on Wall Street.
The Dow was up about 30 points when London markets closed.
Dealers said the market was getting increasingly nervous about that the sharp appreciation of the currency would continue to cut into the profits of multinational corporations.
